What is the ionic strength of the final solution?

A. 1.397e-01
B. 1.394e-01
C. 1.399e-01
D. 1.391e-01

SOLUTION 1 Pure water
    pH 7 charge
    temp 25
    units mol/kgw
    water 1
REACTION 1
    H2SO4 1
    0.001 0.005 0.01 0.05 0.1
    INCREMENTAL false
SELECTED_OUTPUT
    -reset false
    -high_precision true
    -simulation true
    -state true
    -ionic_strength true
END
"}
